name: Approval Route
description: One record kind's internal approval steps before and after the client (approvals design §14.2; P3-82). Site-level, never project-scoped or client-readable; written by a System Manager. Each save appends an Approval Route Version and rings every Construction Manager. No route: the request goes straight to the client.
